description: RWTH Aachen provides the dataset accompanying a battery-system digital-twin study. The native description identifies a cloud battery-management system with online state-of-charge and state-of-health estimation. The format metadata lists MATLAB data, text and ZIP components. The source parent collection establishes the EVERLASTING vehicle-battery monitoring, prediction and management context. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent collection establishes calibration inputs for predicting electric-vehicle battery behaviour, lifetime and range. Coverage: exact measurement periods remain unstated. Access: public native metadata describes the release and stated formats. Licence: CC0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The source describes data accompanying the system and does not establish an available cloud service or general simulation platform. Detailed variable schemas, observation periods and runtime API access are unstated. This release has a distinct native identity from electrochemical state-estimation data.
